test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

They think that the Governor will resign.

options.text: It is thought that the Governor will be resigning.
It is thought that the Governor will resign.
They thought that the Governor would be resigning.
They think that the Governor is resigning.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The active sentence is: **“They think that the Governor will resign.”**
 
• In the passive voice, the structure is: **It is thought that + clause**.
 
• The verb **“think”** is changed to its passive form **“is thought”**.
 
• The clause “the Governor will resign” remains unchanged because it is already in the future tense.
 
• Thus, the sentence becomes: **“It is thought that the Governor will resign.”**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *“It is thought that the Governor will resign.”*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** “It is thought that the Governor will be resigning.” – Incorrect because the future continuous tense (“will be resigning”) changes the original meaning.
 
• **Option 3:** “They thought that the Governor would be resigning.” – Incorrect; it changes the tense to past (“thought”) and alters the meaning.
 
• **Option 4:** “They think that the Governor is resigning.” – Incorrect; it remains in the active voice and uses the present continuous tense.
